dict.string: Intermezzo runs the AppleScript rules you enable (for example "pause during a screen share") and asks other apps such as System Events only what those rules need.
Intermezzo checks calendar event titles only to detect meetings (e.g. "Work", "Praca") and pause breaks during them.
Intermezzo does not read your health data; it only writes water intake when you log a drink.
Intermezzo writes your logged drinks (water, tea, coffee, juice) to Health as water intake so your daily hydration total appears in the Health app. Nothing else is shared.

Intermezzo uses your location for two things only: current weather for the break background (one anonymous request to api.open-meteo.com every 15 minutes) and, if you turn on the work log, the names of nearby Wi-Fi networks, which macOS reveals only to apps with location access. Nothing is stored or sent elsewhere.
